scope: Ten unresolved HEMS clinic/optical records; alternate OSM categories and duplicate/closed-vs-active identity checks.
source_hierarchy: Live HEMS Ministry of Health establishment directory
Official HPA/health-regulatory listings and EyeCare operator material where available
OSM API, Nominatim, and targeted Overpass scans
Google Maps/Search discovery for address and branch context only
source_access_issues: The indexed HPA private-facilities PDF URLs returned HTTP 404 when fetched directly during this review; HPA search-indexed evidence was retained as secondary context, while live HEMS was used for current status/identity.
decision_policy: An exact or plausible name under shop=optician, amenity=doctors, healthcare=doctor, pharmacy, generic office, building, hospital, or resort context is not a confirmed clinic mapping without compatible identity/category and location evidence. Absence from OSM is coverage evidence only, not proof of nonexistence.
